generation_seed_role: fresh sampling draws, not independent meters or training seeds

methods.interpretation: Common unconditional Gaussian source with the candidate physical inverse transform; no learned map or equipment conditioning. Equivalent sources across training seeds share one diagnostic, not independent replicates.
Independent uniforms through the same conditional empirical inverse; no learned dependence. Shared fitted marginals across training seeds create one control, not extra replicates.

source_controls: One matched source-only control per declared prior kind, applied float32 factor and physical inverse affine transform; legacy missing priors mean isotropic. Use identical labels, order and fresh seeds.
baseline_fit: Fit each mean/resample/copula once on the identical full inner TRAIN; generate the same fresh draws.
